# Approachable Intelligence

> AI integration and automation for small and medium service businesses. We help owners adopt AI without losing the human quality that made their business work. Tagline: Big Tech Energy. Small Business Soul. Based in Colorado (Denver and the Roaring Fork Valley), working locally and remotely. Founded by Ty and Jordyn.

## What we do

Approachable Intelligence is an AI integration and web development consultancy for service businesses that have outgrown their systems. We automate the busywork your customers never see (data entry, follow-ups, reminders, lead routing) and protect the human moments they feel. We also coach teams so the new tools actually get used.

Our process runs in three phases:

- The Deep Dive (48-hour blueprint): a two-hour audit of your "digital junk drawer" to find lead leakage, manual duct tape, and invisible labor. You get a map of what to delete, automate, and protect.
- The Build (setup and buy-in): we install the automated architecture and coach the team to adopt it, so the business runs smoother.
- The Alliance (ongoing support): on-call partners who refine the roadmap as AI evolves.

## Who we help

Small and medium service businesses dealing with operational bottlenecks, scattered data and double-entry, underused software and AI tools, and the worry that automation will make their service feel cold.
